## Checklist

- [ ] The change was agreed in an issue first.
- [ ] `claude plugin validate`, the typecheck and `claude plugin test` pass locally (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] A change in behaviour comes with a test that fails without it.
- [ ] A change on screen comes with updated pictures in the README, or says here why none is needed.
- [ ] No version change: the version is raised at release time.
